Серия 2 «Ужин при всех»: промпты для картинок (версия 2)

Версия 1 была неверной: основой я взял v6, а он слишком меловой, плюс в тексте стояло «chalk-white». Здесь основа v4 (ваш утверждённый), кожа и взгляд берутся с вашего эталона C08, в запретах «не белая маска, не клоун, не вытаращенные глаза».

Формат 9:16, качество 2K, Nano Banana Pro (блюда B1–B6 можно на 2.1). Референсы прикреплять в указанном порядке слева направо. Файлы: папка louis_ep2/refs/ (R1–R6).

The king (the king from the FIRST reference image, exactly the same man, wearing and looking like the first image, but with the SKIN and the EXPRESSION of the SECOND reference image (the owner's own frame): natural matte court powder in a light ivory-grey tone like old paper, NOT a white mask, NOT chalky, NOT clown or mime makeup; visible pores, fine lines and wrinkles, slight natural unevenness of the skin; heavy upper eyelids, a haughty disdainful lowered gaze, the eyes NOT wide open, one eyebrow slightly raised, the mouth closed in a contemptuous half-smile; muted grey-green eyes; only a faint warm tint on the cheekbones, no round pink patches; long straight nose, thin upturned waxed moustache, a small dark beauty spot beside the mouth; a tall grey-white powdered wavy wig with a high swept-up front, rolled curls above the ears and long curls falling over both shoulders to the chest; a scarlet velvet coat embroidered with gold suns, a white lace cravat with a white linen napkin tucked into it) with his mouth slightly open mid-word and the haughty heavy lids. The dark mass covering the upper half is HIS OWN scarlet velvet sleeve with gold embroidery and his fist, very close to the lens. A little grey wig curl at the left edge, a blurred candlelit table and crowd behind.
